Care for your skin.

Read and follow the full pack directions before every use. Patch test as directed before treating a larger area. Do not exceed the stated application time.

For external use only. Do not use on broken or irritated skin, the face, genitals or mucous membranes. Bikini line means the external bikini-line area only.

If irritation or burning occurs, stop use, remove the product and rinse thoroughly. Follow the product label for further guidance.
